text: A hunter drawn to tears in the lattice. It closes distance quickly but cannot cross worlds by itself.
Rift Hounds hunt on the March Steppe, in the Highlands and in the Ember Wastes.
It has **28 health** and **2 armour** and hits for **5**. It is the fastest of the remnants, so you will not easily outrun one. Turn and fight with your back to a wall.
pages.title: Where and how

text: A Rift Tooth attunes into 2 Attuned Echoes under Spirit.
pages.title: What it gives

text: Reach **Voice** with the **Edge-walkers**, then use a Bonding Charm on an adult: two tries in five, charm spent on failure.
A bonded hound is a fighter, and the rare **Track** mark shows you the last foe that hurt you. See [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts).
